business_description.value: Holori provides a FinOps and cloud infrastructure visibility platform for centralizing cloud costs, allocating and optimizing spending, visualizing cloud infrastructure, monitoring infrastructure changes, and automating infrastructure documentation.

cloud_signals.value: Holori offers a hosted software platform accessible through app.holori.com and provides cloud cost management, FinOps, and infrastructure visualization capabilities.
Holori connects with customer AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts using read-only access to generate infrastructure diagrams, monitor changes, and display resource configurations and costs.
Holori supports centralized cloud cost data from multiple providers, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle.

sales_summary.text: Holori is a FinOps software provider offering cloud cost visibility, allocation, optimization, and infrastructure visualization for engineering and finance teams.
Its platform connects to customer cloud accounts, including AWS, Azure, and GCP, to map infrastructure, monitor changes, and associate costs with cloud resources.

business_description.value: Holori is a SaaS FinOps and cloud infrastructure visibility platform that helps organizations centralize, visualize, allocate, monitor, and optimize cloud costs and infrastructure across providers including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle.

cloud_signals.value: Holori provides a SaaS service for managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure across multiple cloud providers.
The platform connects with read-only access to AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts to generate infrastructure diagrams and monitor resource changes.
Holori centralizes cloud costs from multiple providers, provides optimization recommendations, and supports cost allocation and reporting.
The service is accessed through Holori web applications, including app.holori.com.

sales_summary.text: Holori is a French SaaS provider offering FinOps, cloud cost management, infrastructure visualization, monitoring, and optimization capabilities for AWS, Azure, GCP, and other cloud environments.
Its platform connects to customer cloud accounts, centralizes billing and usage data, and provides dashboards, diagrams, allocation tools, alerts, and optimization recommendations.
Holori SAS is identified in its terms as the French contracting entity, with a registered office in Toulouse, France.
